evidence_quotes.agenda: 'Before I discuss the pricing structure and your estimate, do you have any questions or concerns about the moving process?' — asked after probing had started.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: 'No, I've already did it... nothing crazy' — no concern raised; full credit.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'This is only my estimate. If it only takes about the minimum of two and a half hours, then you will only be billed for that' — matches the 'pay less if beats it' line.

top_strength: Clean, well-personalized range estimate (called out the same-complex, different-building stair access).
coaching_note: No Sheet 1/2 differentiators (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover) or the takeaway (On-Time/Communication) were ever covered — customer got price and logistics but no trust-building content.
